usage: workflow hermes [-h]
                       {inventory,preflight,analyze,qwen-preview,qwen-connectivity} ...

Run deterministic read-only dry-run inventory, preflight, bounded analysis,
and offline Qwen request/prompt preview, or the explicit operator-gated no-
content DashScope connectivity probe. Live response parsing, migration writes,
report writing, Qwen/DashScope analysis, and Graphify remain deferred.

positional arguments:
  {inventory,preflight,analyze,qwen-preview,qwen-connectivity}
    inventory           Classify repos across configured roots without writing
    preflight           Evaluate shallow Hermes readiness facts without
                        writing
    analyze             Summarize deterministic preflight facts without
                        writing
    qwen-preview        Preview the offline Qwen request/prompt contract
                        without writing
    qwen-connectivity   Run the explicit operator-gated no-content DashScope
                        connectivity probe

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
